ON CURRY.

For Chef Raj, curry was never just something on the table. It was home, memory and the beginning of everything.

THE STORY OF RAJ ROTI · 01

From the beginning

THE FLAVOUR CAME FIRST.

Chef Raj grew up in curry. It was in the kitchen, in the yard and in the air—the scent of toasted spice, a bubbling pot and roti warming nearby.

Those flavours taught him that the best food does more than fill a plate. It gathers people. It carries stories. It can take you back home before the first bite is finished.

Over time, knowing curry by heart became a craft. Raj learned to trust the colour, the aroma and the feel of the pot: when the seasoning had opened up, when the meat was ready, when the gravy was just right.

“

YOU COULD TASTE WHEN FOOD IS MADE WITH PATIENCE.

— Chef Raj

The craft

A ROTI WITH ROOTS.

Raj Roti grew from a simple idea: serve the food Chef Raj knows best, the way he believes it should be—hot, generous and full of flavour.

  1. 01

    Start with spice

    Build the curry slowly so every layer gets time to develop.

  2. 02

    Cook with patience

    Let the filling become tender, rich and ready to soak into the roti.

  3. 03

    Wrap it fresh

    Bring it together while everything is hot, soft and at its best.
